about: One row per measured arm of each published benchmark dataset in docs/benchmarks/, written by bench/report/manifest.py (draft.py appends a run's rows). A row with comparison or carried_from is not a new measurement. Sorted by date, report, variant.

2026-10-18-terminal-bench-v1-high.label: Terminal-Bench 2.0 at the v1 freeze, HIGH tier: all 89 tasks × 3, every harness at high effort
2026-10-18-terminal-bench-v1-high.about: The v1 freeze, HIGH tier: Theseus as shipped (Jev routing each message's model and effort, capped at high) against Claude Code, OpenCode and Pi at high effort, on every task, three attempts an arm.

conditions.text: Effort is not one setting: Theseus's Jev picked each message's effort within bounds of low to high, while each rival was set to high.
The caps are of different kinds: the rivals ran at $2 and 200 turns a trial; Theseus ran with a $20 spend limit that reserves each call's price first.
conditions.quote: a $20 spend limit (reservations) and a 60 s command wait

conditions.text: Theseus's Jev routed across Anthropic profiles; the three rivals ran Claude Sonnet 5.5 alone.
conditions.quote: the three rivals on Claude Sonnet 5.5

theseus-routed.text: chosen per message by Jev, bounds low to high

2026-10-18-terminal-bench-v1-max.label: Terminal-Bench 2.0 at the v1 freeze, MAX tier: the 30 hard tasks × 3, every harness at its top effort
2026-10-18-terminal-bench-v1-max.about: The v1 freeze, MAX tier: the 30 hard tasks, three attempts an arm, every harness at its top effort, regardless of cost.

conditions.text: Each harness's top effort differs in name: Claude Code and OpenCode at max, Pi at xhigh, Theseus free to choose up to max.
conditions.quote: Claude Code at `max`, OpenCode at `max`, and Pi at `xhigh`

conditions.text: The caps were $5 and 300 turns a trial, and OpenCode's did not hold: its harness does not stop at the cap.
conditions.quote: its harness does not stop at the cap

conditions.text: Only the 30 hard tasks ran, where effort can matter.

theseus-routed.text: chosen per message by Jev, bounds low to max
theseus-routed.quote: Theseus ran as shipped, with Jev free to choose up to `max`.
